<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc-4</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc-4">Released</a> on January 17, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Upgrade meshkit @Revolyssup (#4949)</li>
<li>[Fix] Remove Redundant NATS Connections in Subscriptions @sudo-NithishKarthik (#4941)</li>
<li>Add the new chart to meshery and meshery-operator @Aisuko (#4918)</li>
<li>[Patterns] Query resolver for Get Patterns @bariqhibat (#4925)</li>
<li>Add @piyushsingariya to MAINTAINERS.md @verma-kunal (#4899)</li>
<li>chore[Readme]: Added Aditya Chatterjee as a Docs Maintainers @Abhijay007 (#4897)</li>
<li>Close all database connections safely before exiting in dev environment  @Revolyssup (#4873)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[mesheryctl] Support quoted args and refactoring code in <code>mesheryctl perf</code> @piyushsingariya (#4823)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Replaced <code>adapters</code> with <code>components</code> in meshconfig @piyushsingariya (#4905)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] add suggestions for <code>context switch</code> invalid arguments @bisakhmondal (#4876)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Chaining token functions for authentication @hexxdump (#4887)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Adding MesheryReadinessHealthCheck for <code>system start</code> @piyushsingariya (#4874)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Added unit test for healthcheck.go @afzal442 (#4403)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI] fixed text-cutoff @asubedy (#4950)</li>
<li>[Server] Add support for deleting multiple patterns without exploiting requests @Abhishek-kumar09 (#4324)</li>
<li>style changes to text field in RJSF @warunicorn19 (#4934)</li>
<li>[RJSF/Extension] Fix Name and Namespace Fileds @Abhishek-kumar09 (#4928)</li>
<li>[UI] Fix : Change UI to send json request for user preferences @manav1403 (#4913)</li>
<li>[pattern/url-import] Realtime URL validator for URL import @Abhishek-kumar09 (#4931)</li>
<li>[Patterns] Fix Pattern upload/update issues from the patterns &amp; configurator page @Abhishek-kumar09 (#4929)</li>
<li>fixed release link not openeing in new tab @asubedy (#4910)</li>
<li>UI: Fixed logo hyperlink in the navbar @Nikhil-Ladha (#4906)</li>
<li>pre-commit hook lint-staged config: Remove git add &amp; invoke eslint &ndash;fix w/out path (lint-staged does this for us) @MarioArriaga92 (#4902)</li>
<li>Bump lint-staged from 11.1.1 to 12.1.5 in /ui @dependabot (#4884)</li>
<li>[UI] Pattern Configurator enhancement  @Chadha93 (#4890)</li>
<li>[Navigator] Hide scrollbar while still be able to scroll @Abhishek-kumar09 (#4888)</li>
<li>shift to localhost ref for adapters @leecalcote (#4871)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-patterns-filters-applications">
	🔋 Patterns, Filters, Applications
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Server] Add support for deleting multiple patterns without exploiting requests @Abhishek-kumar09 (#4324)</li>
<li>[pattern/url-import] Realtime URL validator for URL import @Abhishek-kumar09 (#4931)</li>
<li>[Patterns] Fix Pattern upload/update issues from the patterns &amp; configurator page @Abhishek-kumar09 (#4929)</li>
<li>[UI] Pattern Configurator enhancement  @Chadha93 (#4890)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Moved to meshkit&rsquo;s new gitwalker which doesn&rsquo;t use api.github.com @Revolyssup (#4667)</li>
<li>Bump fortio.org/fortio from 1.19.0 to 1.20.0 @dependabot (#4866)</li>
<li>[Cl] Update Slack Workflow @theBeginner86 (#4927)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/briandowns/spinner from 1.16.0 to 1.18.0 @dependabot (#4868)</li>
<li>chore[Readme]: Replaced Dhruv Patel with Abhishek Kumar as UI maintainer @Abhijay007 (#4898)</li>
<li>Bump lint-staged from 11.1.1 to 12.1.5 in /ui @dependabot (#4884)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Adding MesheryReadinessHealthCheck for <code>system start</code> @piyushsingariya (#4874)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Added unit test for healthcheck.go @afzal442 (#4403)</li>
<li>Add the current latest tag as the chart version @Aisuko (#4886)</li>
<li>[Chore] Golang dependency updates for MeshKit, Operator, MeshSync @leecalcote (#4877)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/spf13/cobra from 1.2.1 to 1.3.0 @dependabot (#4865)</li>
<li>shift to localhost ref for adapters @leecalcote (#4871)</li>
<li>Use system logs instead of kubectl in core workflow @Revolyssup (#4872)</li>
<li>Replacing kubectl with mesheryctl in workflow @Revolyssup (#4869)</li>
<li>Use mesheryctl command in workflow @Revolyssup (#4847)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[DOCS] Add dropdown arrows in docs Sidebar Menu. #3946 @14Richa (#4752)</li>
<li>[Docs] Update pages/concepts/architecture/architecture.md @verma-kunal (#4924)</li>
<li>[DOCS] Fixed Slack link @amoghjalan (#4923)</li>
<li>[Docs] Redirect from trailing slash reference @leecalcote (#4919)</li>
<li>Doc fix for Providers @MUzairS15 (#4908)</li>
<li>[docs] Fix typo in the earliest service mesh versions @theBeginner86 (#4912)</li>
<li>Removed files with colon in name @Revolyssup (#4894)</li>
<li>[Docs] Filter non-English pages from Operation Guides list @MUzairS15 (#4891)</li>
<li>[Docs] Fix Typo For Istio Adapter @theBeginner86 (#4880)</li>
<li>shift to localhost ref for adapters @leecalcote (#4871)</li>
<li>[Docs] Relocate version selector @leecalcote (#4852)</li>
<li>[Docs] Styling of Docs overview page @leecalcote (#4851)</li>
<li>[Docs] Add &ldquo;framework/jekyll&rdquo; label @leecalcote (#4849)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-security">
	🔒 Security
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[CI] Security: Upgrade to docker image to Alpine 3.15 @leecalcote (#4838)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc-5</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc-5">Released</a> on February 11, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Minor fix in makefile @Revolyssup (#5052)</li>
<li>Remove Rudraksh from CI maintainers @Revolyssup (#5051)</li>
<li>Add support for importing patterns via URL inside services @Revolyssup (#5038)</li>
<li>addendum to the existing governance policy @warunicorn19 (#4992)</li>
<li>Upgrade github.com/Mesheryio/nighthawk-go to v0.5.0 @gyohuangxin (#4999)</li>
<li>[Extensions] Addition remote config component @Chadha93 (#4985)</li>
<li>Fix: Visualizer crashes on first try | CU-1x74e8a @manav1403 (#4984)</li>
<li>Update affiliation @verma-kunal (#4983)</li>
<li>[Docs] Handbook info addition | CU-1ydvcdq @Chadha93 (#4969)</li>
<li>Fix traefik mesh and istio helm charts @Revolyssup (#4970)</li>
<li>Added Site Maintainers @debo19 (#4962)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[mesheryctl] Make system stop &ndash;force not return errors @gr455 (#5057)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] bug: stop restart on non-confirmation @navendu-pottekkat (#5044)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Make <code>stop</code> wait for namespace to be deleted  @gr455 (#5021)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Minor issue with docker platform deployment @piyushsingariya (#5045)</li>
<li>[chore] Cleaning repeatitive code in utils folder @piyushsingariya (#4690)</li>
<li>switched IsMesheryRunning with AreMesheryComponentsRunning @piyushsingariya (#5020)</li>
<li>Added flag to control browser behaviour @MUzairS15 (#4959)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Applications] Meshery Application Upload Fix @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5056)</li>
<li>feat: add rjsf-json-schema-builder @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5018)</li>
<li>[UI] Prevent duplicate snackbar 🐛 bug fix @Chadha93 (#5016)</li>
<li>[UI] removed the configuration/edit button @asubedy (#5010)</li>
<li>fixed zIndex of the service-mesh selector @asubedy (#5013)</li>
<li>set cursor to pointer @Sunnyio (#5011)</li>
<li>Bump cached-path-relative from 1.0.2 to 1.1.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5000)</li>
<li>[Extensions] icon for meshmap @warunicorn19 (#5005)</li>
<li>[Extensions] Icons to remote config @warunicorn19 (#5004)</li>
<li>Bump cached-path-relative from 1.0.2 to 1.1.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5001)</li>
<li>Bump nanoid from 3.1.23 to 3.2.0 in /ui @dependabot (#4996)</li>
<li>Bump nanoid from 3.1.25 to 3.2.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#4995)</li>
<li>[Chore] Octarine deprecation (partial) @leecalcote (#4988)</li>
<li>[FIX]:UI Aligned in Pattern Configration @Sonichigo (#4990)</li>
<li>[Perf] [UI] Added Subscription for performance Test @manav1403 (#4963)</li>
<li>[UI] shifted the create pattern button to custom-toolbar: @asubedy (#4973)</li>
<li>[UI} added style prop to  MesheryPerformanceComponent component @manav1403 (#4976)</li>
<li>[RJSF Add validation to the RJSF form | CU-1zgbtk0 @sudo-NithishKarthik (#4975)</li>
<li>[UI] Swap mailing list with discussion forum link @leecalcote (#4965)</li>
<li>fixed success message on pinging grafana @warunicorn19 (#4957)</li>
<li>Added Error state handling card to sparkline charts also | CU-1yz3q75 @manav1403 (#4955)</li>
<li>fixed success message for kubernetes chip @warunicorn19 (#4952)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-patterns-filters-applications">
	🔋 Patterns, Filters, Applications
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Applications] Meshery Application Upload Fix @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5056)</li>
<li>Improve application endpoint @Revolyssup (#5055)</li>
<li>Remove core.Service @Revolyssup (#4974)</li>
<li>Fix #4942 @utkarsh-pro (#4960)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump github.com/meshery/meshery-operator from 0.5.1 to 0.5.2 @dependabot (#5027)</li>
<li>[chore] Cleaning repeatitive code in utils folder @piyushsingariya (#4690)</li>
<li>Bump cached-path-relative from 1.0.2 to 1.1.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5000)</li>
<li>Bump cached-path-relative from 1.0.2 to 1.1.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5001)</li>
<li>Bump nanoid from 3.1.23 to 3.2.0 in /ui @dependabot (#4996)</li>
<li>Bump nanoid from 3.1.25 to 3.2.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#4995)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Docs] updated compatibility matrix page to show tests according to service-mesh @asubedy (#5009)</li>
<li>increase navbar width in docs @Sunnyio (#5041)</li>
<li>[UI]: Refactors meshery docs footer to match with Meshery and Meshery websites. @Nik-09 (#5017)</li>
<li>[Docs] API: Authentication tokens - incorporated feedback @leecalcote (#4997)</li>
<li>Updated the get token part @unnati914 (#4980)</li>
<li>added missing mesheryctl guides @Vidyaa123 (#4940)</li>
<li>[docs] adding documentation for OAM URLS @piyushsingariya (#4943)</li>
</ul>

                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc-5a</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc-5a">Released</a> on February 18, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Fix context switching for None provider @Revolyssup (#5086)</li>
<li>update meshkit version @warunicorn19 (#5071)</li>
<li>allow 201 code from meshery cloud while saving k8s context @Revolyssup (#5065)</li>
<li>fix k8s registeration bug after multi-context PR @Revolyssup (#5064)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[mesheryctl] Mesheryctl moves with Meshkit logger @piyushsingariya (#5085)</li>
<li>Fix/mesh deploy hang/#4313 @Zanda256 (#5059)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] minor change in skip-browser flag functionality @piyushsingariya (#5066)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>updated style and fixed search in context switcher @warunicorn19 (#5090)</li>
<li>[UI] Multi-Context Switcher: style changes and bug fix @warunicorn19 (#5081)</li>
<li>[UI] Updated Sidebar of Meshery According to New Figma Design @YashKamboj (#5079)</li>
<li>Bump follow-redirects from 1.11.0 to 1.14.8 in /ui @dependabot (#5061)</li>
<li>Fix Multi-Context @utkarsh-pro (#5076)</li>
<li>Bump nanoid from 3.1.23 to 3.3.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5072)</li>
<li>Bump cached-path-relative from 1.0.2 to 1.1.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5073)</li>
<li>Bump follow-redirects from 1.14.1 to 1.14.8 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5062)</li>
<li>[Extension] Add loading component for the load of meshery extension @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5063)</li>
<li>modify cypress tests after multi-ctx PR @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5069)</li>
<li>[Perf] fixed search issue @asubedy (#4915)</li>
<li>Fix Meshery Crash on loading lifecycle @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5067)</li>
<li>Multi-Context Support @utkarsh-pro (#4218)</li>
<li>Redux: Extract drawer collapse variable with redux @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5058)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump github.com/prometheus/client_golang from 1.11.0 to 1.12.1 @dependabot (#5025)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/meshery/meshsync from 0.1.30 to 0.5.0 @dependabot (#5049)</li>
<li>Bump follow-redirects from 1.11.0 to 1.14.8 in /ui @dependabot (#5061)</li>
<li>Bump nanoid from 3.1.23 to 3.3.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5072)</li>
<li>Bump cached-path-relative from 1.0.2 to 1.1.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5073)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/meshery/meshkit from 0.5.2 to 0.5.6 @dependabot (#5074)</li>
<li>Bump follow-redirects from 1.14.1 to 1.14.8 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5062)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>removed slack and spanish @warunicorn19 (#5088)</li>
<li>[Docs] Improving navigability of error code guide @shubham-tyagi (#4981)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Revolyssup, @YashKamboj, @Zanda256, @asubedy, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @hexxdump, @l5io, @leecalcote, @navendu-pottekkat, @piyushsingariya, @shubham-tyagi, @sudo-NithishKarthik, @utkarsh-pro and @warunicorn19</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc-5b</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc-5b">Released</a> on March 05, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Fix redundant kubeopenjsonschema instances running at a time @Revolyssup (#5147)</li>
<li>Revert &ldquo;Bump k8s.io/apiextensions-apiserver from 0.22.4 to 0.23.4&rdquo; @leecalcote (#5158)</li>
<li>[Lifecycle] Remove unused protos @theBeginner86 (#5114)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[mesheryctl] Check for expired tokens/expired token error message @cpepper96 (#4989)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] <code>--force</code> flag does not return CR delete errors @gr455 (#5084)</li>
<li>Updated the UX @chinmaym07 (#5119)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI][Bug Hunt] Cluster Switcher + nav toggle btn fix | CU-22qqma1 @Chadha93 (#5143)</li>
<li>Bump prop-types from 15.7.2 to 15.8.1 in /ui @dependabot (#5137)</li>
<li>Bump @fortawesome/free-regular-svg-icons from 5.15.4 to 6.0.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5148)</li>
<li>Bumped down styled-jsx version @adi611 (#5122)</li>
<li>Bump react-dom from 16.13.1 to 16.14.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5132)</li>
<li>Bump cypress from 9.2.0 to 9.5.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5153)</li>
<li>Bump eslint-plugin-react from 7.28.0 to 7.29.2 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5136)</li>
<li>Bump eslint-plugin-react-hooks from 4.2.0 to 4.3.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5139)</li>
<li>Bump @babel/types from 7.16.0 to 7.17.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5138)</li>
<li>trasitioned from patterns to designs @warunicorn19 (#5116)</li>
<li>[UI] Added Kubernetes context switcher slide transition @NikhilSharma03 (#5126)</li>
<li>changed the upload patterns modal @warunicorn19 (#5120)</li>
<li>[CI] [Cypress] Add E2E tests to Deploy Filters Configuration through Meshery UI @MarioArriaga92 (#4717)</li>
<li>Add support for handling x-kubernetes-int-or-string @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5106)</li>
<li>[UI] Fix UI crash due to invalid hook call @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5098)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-patterns-filters-applications">
	🔋 Patterns, Filters, Applications
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[CI] [Cypress] Add E2E tests to Deploy Filters Configuration through Meshery UI @MarioArriaga92 (#4717)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump prop-types from 15.7.2 to 15.8.1 in /ui @dependabot (#5137)</li>
<li>Bump @fortawesome/free-regular-svg-icons from 5.15.4 to 6.0.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5148)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/99designs/gqlgen from 0.17.0 to 0.17.1 @dependabot (#5164)</li>
<li>[Docs] Integrationn Test Results: visual enhancement @leecalcote (#5145)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/99designs/gqlgen from 0.14.0 to 0.17.0 @dependabot (#5160)</li>
<li>Bump gorm.io/gorm from 1.22.2 to 1.23.2 @dependabot (#5152)</li>
<li>Bump k8s.io/apiextensions-apiserver from 0.22.4 to 0.23.4 @dependabot (#5095)</li>
<li>Bump react-dom from 16.13.1 to 16.14.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5132)</li>
<li>Bump cypress from 9.2.0 to 9.5.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5153)</li>
<li>Bump eslint-plugin-react from 7.28.0 to 7.29.2 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5136)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/briandowns/spinner from 1.18.0 to 1.18.1 @dependabot (#5149)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/gorilla/websocket from 1.4.2 to 1.5.0 @dependabot (#5142)</li>
<li>Bump eslint-plugin-react-hooks from 4.2.0 to 4.3.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5139)</li>
<li>Bump @babel/types from 7.16.0 to 7.17.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5138)</li>
<li>Moving ramrodo to contributor team. @Aisuko (#5104)</li>
<li>[CI] [Cypress] Add E2E tests to Deploy Filters Configuration through Meshery UI @MarioArriaga92 (#4717)</li>
<li>[meshery] Point the github-actions bot to the correct link for &ldquo;Contributing to Meshery UI&rdquo; @adi611 (#5103)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">

<li>[Docs] Fixing the page layout CSS @sidd-oo (#5124)</li>
<li>[Docs] Updated contributing for UI and Docs @shubhangi013 (#5130)</li>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc-5c</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc-5c">Released</a> on March 21, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[WIP] Init Docker Extension UI @theBeginner86 (#5242)</li>
<li>[meshery] Add support for cilium adapter @hexxdump (#5238)</li>
<li>Remove whitespace from k8s generated components @Revolyssup (#5226)</li>
<li>Update swagger.yaml @zahertalab (#5216)</li>
<li>Add Mario to CI maintainers list @alphaX86 (#5219)</li>
<li>[DOCS] Maintainers file update @Chadha93 (#5223)</li>
<li>get latest wasm filters from latest release @Revolyssup (#5176)</li>
<li>[WIP] Meshery perf helm @hershd23 (#5166)</li>
<li>handle panic when preference load test is not provided in UserPrefsHandler @sourikghosh (#5177)</li>
<li>Update README.md - Content misaligned in the main readme file @RakeshPotnuru (#5189)</li>
<li>Fix #5180 @Revolyssup (#5183)</li>
<li>Set appropriate metadata.name for namespace @Revolyssup (#5175)</li>
<li>Transition of role for Utkarsh @leecalcote (#5178)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Meshery] added cilium as component @piyushsingariya (#5234)</li>
<li>Fixed spacing on error message. @cpepper96 (#5230)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Introducing <code>--port-forward</code> in <code>system dashboard</code> @piyushsingariya (#5053)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>add cilium @warunicorn19 (#5235)</li>
<li>[UI] Replicate Imports for Filters and Application similar to Patterns and fix e2e failure @SAEb-ai (#5213)</li>
<li>More settings options in remote provider tab @theBeginner86 (#5217)</li>
<li>fix: Accept the rjsf custom components from the Meshery Extension @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5225)</li>
<li>[CI] UI: OS and Arch for fsevents package @leecalcote (#5224)</li>
<li>[UI] Pattern update and delete handler call 🐛 bug fix  @Chadha93 (#5208)</li>
<li>Revert &ldquo;[UI] Replicate Imports for Filters and Applications similar to Patterns&rdquo; @leecalcote (#5212)</li>
<li>[UI] Replicate Imports for Filters and Applications similar to Patterns @SAEb-ai (#5203)</li>
<li>removed deprecated grpc option @sourikghosh (#5200)</li>
<li>Bump next from 11.1.3 to 12.1.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5089)</li>
<li>Bump relay-runtime from 11.0.2 to 13.1.1 in /ui @dependabot (#5135)</li>
<li>[UI][Server] Update API endpoint call @Chadha93 (#5197)</li>
<li>[UI] Dashboard service mesh proxy tooltip  @Chadha93 (#5202)</li>
<li>Bump eslint-config-next from 11.1.3 to 12.1.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5133)</li>
<li>Bump @babel/traverse from 7.16.3 to 7.17.3 in /ui @dependabot (#5185)</li>
<li>Bump eslint-config-airbnb from 18.2.1 to 19.0.4 in /ui @dependabot (#5186)</li>
<li>[UI] Fixed Context Menu peek behaviour @NikhilSharma03 (#5188)</li>
<li>Bump @fortawesome/free-brands-svg-icons from 5.15.4 to 6.0.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5155)</li>
<li>[UI][Bug Hunt] Enabled clickaway feature on the context-switcher | CU-232yuch @asubedy (#5181)</li>
<li>Bump lint-staged from 12.3.3 to 12.3.5 in /ui @dependabot (#5182)</li>
<li>Bump billboard.js from 3.2.1 to 3.3.3 in /ui @dependabot (#5156)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-patterns-filters-applications">
	🔋 Patterns, Filters, Applications
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Remove UUIDs from being service name of designs and add depends-on @Revolyssup (#5218)</li>
<li>Add name field for pattern request to avoid &ldquo;MesheryGeneratedPatternFile&rdquo; @Revolyssup (#5207)</li>
<li>[UI] Pattern update and delete handler call 🐛 bug fix  @Chadha93 (#5208)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[CI] Update and add tests, glob expressions for backend files in CodeCov @alphaX86 (#5240)</li>
<li>[Meshery] added cilium as component @piyushsingariya (#5234)</li>
<li>Hardcoded image name for DDE @hershd23 (#5241)</li>
<li>Workflow for Docker Desktop Extension @hershd23 (#5236)</li>
<li>Fixed spacing on error message. @cpepper96 (#5230)</li>
<li>[CI] Docs: Move to Ruby 2.7.5 @leecalcote (#5222)</li>
<li>Bump next from 11.1.3 to 12.1.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5089)</li>
<li>Bump relay-runtime from 11.0.2 to 13.1.1 in /ui @dependabot (#5135)</li>
<li>Bump eslint-config-next from 11.1.3 to 12.1.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5133)</li>
<li>Bump @babel/traverse from 7.16.3 to 7.17.3 in /ui @dependabot (#5185)</li>
<li>Bump eslint-config-airbnb from 18.2.1 to 19.0.4 in /ui @dependabot (#5186)</li>
<li>Bump fortio.org/fortio from 1.20.0 to 1.21.0 @dependabot (#5161)</li>
<li>Bump @fortawesome/free-brands-svg-icons from 5.15.4 to 6.0.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5155)</li>
<li>Bump lint-staged from 12.3.3 to 12.3.5 in /ui @dependabot (#5182)</li>
<li>Bump billboard.js from 3.2.1 to 3.3.3 in /ui @dependabot (#5156)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Update CONTRIBUTING.md @RakeshPotnuru (#5221)</li>
<li>Update contributing-docs.md w/signoff @RakeshPotnuru (#5191)</li>
<li>Added port 10013 to docs to reserve the port @hershd23 (#5179)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:

    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc-5g</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc-5g">Released</a> on March 28, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>added targetarch to dockerfile @warunicorn19 (#5289)</li>
<li>changed ui @warunicorn19 (#5288)</li>
<li>[Docs] DDE: readme @leecalcote (#5284)</li>
<li>Fix:  failing deployement of argo-rollout due to invalid name @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5272)</li>
<li>Fix empty dependson @Revolyssup (#5271)</li>

    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc-5i</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc-5i">Released</a> on April 02, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Deployments and services for cilium mesh @MUzairS15 (#5315)</li>
<li>migrating material-ui v4 to mui v5 @warunicorn19 (#5303)</li>
<li>[GraphQL] getOAMComponents queryType  @piyushsingariya (#5267)</li>
<li>meshery-perf: disable this chart @leecalcote (#5295)</li>
<li>[DDE] Configure go based proxy for the UI to talk to localhost:9081 @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5299)</li>
<li>removed underline @warunicorn19 (#5296)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[mesheryctl] Fix panic on version check @gr455 (#5298)</li>
<li>Deploying Meshery components under same helm release name @piyushsingariya (#5173)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump cypress from 9.2.0 to 9.5.3 in /ui @dependabot (#5323)</li>
<li>Bump cypress from 9.5.1 to 9.5.3 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5321)</li>
<li>Reverting Bump eslint from 7.32.0 to 8.12.0 in /ui @leecalcote (#5316)</li>
<li>[UI/Pattern] Fix pattern-upload failure @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5314)</li>
<li>minor: use extension in place of MM @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5312)</li>
<li>Bump eslint from 7.32.0 to 8.12.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5302)</li>
<li>[RJSF] Menu-component portal shift for tooltips and add slider for percent @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5304)</li>
<li>Fix: Lifecycle component fix, handling routing and handle unactive adapter @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5307)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump cypress from 9.2.0 to 9.5.3 in /ui @dependabot (#5323)</li>
<li>Bump gonum.org/v1/gonum from 0.9.3 to 0.11.0 @dependabot (#5330)</li>
<li>Bump cypress from 9.5.1 to 9.5.3 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5321)</li>
<li>[Deps] bump to MeshKit v0.5.12 @leecalcote (#5311)</li>
<li>Bump eslint from 7.32.0 to 8.12.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5302)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Docs] Fix typo in markdown @theBeginner86 (#5319)</li>
<li>[Docs] Update for Jekyll server commands @cpepper96 (#5308)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc-5j</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc-5j">Released</a> on April 04, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>fix: image tag of meshery-cilium @gkarthiks (#5338)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Add if block in <code>perf result</code> to avoid panic error @alphaX86 (#5340)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump eslint-plugin-react from 7.29.2 to 7.29.4 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5325)</li>
<li>Bump next from 12.1.0 to 12.1.4 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5322)</li>
<li>Bump eslint-config-next from 12.1.0 to 12.1.4 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5328)</li>
<li>Bump @fortawesome/free-regular-svg-icons from 6.0.0 to 6.1.1 in /ui @dependabot (#5336)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump eslint-plugin-react from 7.29.2 to 7.29.4 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5325)</li>
<li>Bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.44.0 to 1.45.0 @dependabot (#5326)</li>
<li>Bump to later Alpine image @leecalcote (#5341)</li>
<li>Bump next from 12.1.0 to 12.1.4 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5322)</li>
<li>Bump gorm.io/gorm from 1.23.2 to 1.23.3 @dependabot (#5327)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/vektah/gqlparser/v2 from 2.4.0 to 2.4.1 @dependabot (#5335)</li>
<li>Bump eslint-config-next from 12.1.0 to 12.1.4 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5328)</li>
<li>Bump @fortawesome/free-regular-svg-icons from 6.0.0 to 6.1.1 in /ui @dependabot (#5336)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@alphaX86, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @gkarthiks and @leecalcote</p>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc.5aa</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc.5aa">Released</a> on June 25, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Refactor] Make use of validation and formatting functions exposed in Meshkit @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5650)</li>
<li>[DDE] Refactor ws channels  in proxy @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5648)</li>
<li>refactor: Refine ws connection for logout @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5647)</li>
<li>Fix validation error and whitespacing bug @Revolyssup (#5644)</li>
<li>Logout button move @warunicorn19 (#5641)</li>
<li>upgrade meshkit @Revolyssup (#5637)</li>
<li>[DDE] Fix: dde ws undefined @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5636)</li>
<li>[DDE] Fix: Set isLogged to false after logging out @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5635)</li>
<li>[DDE] Fix: automatically change state once logged out @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5634)</li>
<li>fixed issue with logo before login and added logout button @warunicorn19 (#5630)</li>
<li>[Server] Fix error code conflicts @gr455 (#5626)</li>
<li>Allow provider to be set via query parameter @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5627)</li>
<li>Fix failing save context for incluster @Revolyssup (#5601)</li>
<li>[dde] UI Change to adapt to the exposed server version @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5596)</li>
<li>fix: Service mesh provisioning @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5595)</li>
<li>exposed meshery server version in dde @warunicorn19 (#5591)</li>
<li>Fix panic @Revolyssup (#5593)</li>
<li>Fix NATS connectivity test @MUzairS15 (#5583)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>leecalcote/chore/ui deps @leecalcote (#5674)</li>
<li>Make table style consistent @MUzairS15 (#5671)</li>
<li>Changes to the un-deploy icon @asubedy (#5670)</li>
<li>reverted bad commits @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5665)</li>
<li>[Refactor] Update the RJSF form to be overridden by its consumers @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5659)</li>
<li>[Operator Subscription] Fix state variables showing outdated results in callback Fn @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5656)</li>
<li>minor ui fixes @warunicorn19 (#5655)</li>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc.5k</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc.5k">Released</a> on April 08, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Bug] - Fixed Upstream URL Issue @adithyaakrishna (#5359)</li>
<li>potential fix for dde icon @warunicorn19 (#5358)</li>
<li>dde_css @warunicorn19 (#5356)</li>
<li>Update ADOPTERS.md @samirparhi-dev (#5353)</li>
<li>[CI] Workflow DDE @leecalcote (#5351)</li>
<li>Changed Description @hershd23 (#5350)</li>
<li>small changes in dde @warunicorn19 (#5347)</li>
<li>added browse in dde @warunicorn19 (#5343)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump @types/react-relay from 11.0.2 to 13.0.2 in /ui @dependabot (#5332)</li>
<li>Bump babel-plugin-relay from 11.0.2 to 13.2.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5333)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump @types/react-relay from 11.0.2 to 13.0.2 in /ui @dependabot (#5332)</li>
<li>Bump babel-plugin-relay from 11.0.2 to 13.2.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5333)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/99designs/gqlgen from 0.17.1 to 0.17.2 @dependabot (#5324)</li>
<li>[CI] Upgrade setup-go version @alphaX86 (#5354)</li>
<li>[CI] Docker Extension for Meshery workflow @leecalcote (#5352)</li>
<li>[CI] DDE: Fix release channel logic @leecalcote (#5349)</li>
<li>Updated Contributing-gitflow(Readme) @Nandani-Paliwal (#5313)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Nandani-Paliwal, @adithyaakrishna, @alphaX86, @dependabot, @hershd23, @l5io, @leecalcote, @samirparhi-dev and @warunicorn19</p>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc.5l</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc.5l">Released</a> on April 11, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Docker Extension] Proxy: remove unnecessary caps @leecalcote (#5369)</li>
<li>[CI] Made changes to Makefile to enforce usage of go v1.17.8 @asubedy (#5367)</li>
<li>[DDE] Setup Golang proxy for the UI to be able to communicate with Meshery Server @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5365)</li>
<li>[Bug] - Fixed Upstream URL Issue @adithyaakrishna (#5359)</li>
<li>potential fix for dde icon @warunicorn19 (#5358)</li>
<li>dde_css @warunicorn19 (#5356)</li>
<li>Update ADOPTERS.md @samirparhi-dev (#5353)</li>
<li>[CI] Workflow DDE @leecalcote (#5351)</li>
<li>Changed Description @hershd23 (#5350)</li>
<li>small changes in dde @warunicorn19 (#5347)</li>
<li>added browse in dde @warunicorn19 (#5343)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[RJSF] Support Lazy loading of components tooltip in Exntension @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5363)</li>
<li>Bump moment from 2.29.1 to 2.29.2 in /ui @dependabot (#5362)</li>
<li>Bump @types/react-relay from 11.0.2 to 13.0.2 in /ui @dependabot (#5332)</li>
<li>Bump babel-plugin-relay from 11.0.2 to 13.2.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5333)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[CI] Use mesheryctl to start adapters in CI @gr455 (#5361)</li>
<li>Bump moment from 2.29.1 to 2.29.2 in /ui @dependabot (#5362)</li>
<li>Bump @types/react-relay from 11.0.2 to 13.0.2 in /ui @dependabot (#5332)</li>
<li>Bump babel-plugin-relay from 11.0.2 to 13.2.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5333)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/99designs/gqlgen from 0.17.1 to 0.17.2 @dependabot (#5324)</li>
<li>[CI] Upgrade setup-go version @alphaX86 (#5354)</li>
<li>[CI] Docker Extension for Meshery workflow @leecalcote (#5352)</li>
<li>[CI] DDE: Fix release channel logic @leecalcote (#5349)</li>
<li>Updated Contributing-gitflow(Readme) @Nandani-Paliwal (#5313)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc.5m</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc.5m">Released</a> on April 15, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[mesheryctl] Improved UX for bash script installer @cpepper96 (#5371)</li>
<li>Adds HPE Security Engineering as adopter @mchurichi (#5382)</li>
<li>[Visualiser] Add Cluster Name To Visualiser @theBeginner86 (#5348)</li>
<li>Fix failing kubeopenapi binary due to missing library @Revolyssup (#5373)</li>
<li>[Docker Extension] Proxy: remove unnecessary caps @leecalcote (#5369)</li>
<li>[CI] Made changes to Makefile to enforce usage of go v1.17.8 @asubedy (#5367)</li>
<li>[DDE] Setup Golang proxy for the UI to be able to communicate with Meshery Server @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5365)</li>
<li>[Bug] - Fixed Upstream URL Issue @adithyaakrishna (#5359)</li>
<li>potential fix for dde icon @warunicorn19 (#5358)</li>
<li>dde_css @warunicorn19 (#5356)</li>
<li>Update ADOPTERS.md @samirparhi-dev (#5353)</li>
<li>[CI] Workflow DDE @leecalcote (#5351)</li>
<li>Changed Description @hershd23 (#5350)</li>
<li>small changes in dde @warunicorn19 (#5347)</li>
<li>added browse in dde @warunicorn19 (#5343)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI]Designed Multi Cluster Context Switcher Search Box and Chip @Harshit-Dandriyal (#5310)</li>
<li>Bump async from 3.2.0 to 3.2.3 in /ui @dependabot (#5381)</li>
<li>Bump async from 3.2.0 to 3.2.3 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5380)</li>
<li>fix: extension class conflicts due to mui makestyles classNames conflicts @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5383)</li>
<li>Fix: Select All not working @MUzairS15 (#5378)</li>
<li>[UI] Card view of Design Page @asubedy (#5339)</li>
<li>[Extension] Use loading component from extension point @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5372)</li>
<li>[RJSF] Support Lazy loading of components tooltip in Exntension @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5363)</li>
<li>Bump moment from 2.29.1 to 2.29.2 in /ui @dependabot (#5362)</li>
<li>Bump @types/react-relay from 11.0.2 to 13.0.2 in /ui @dependabot (#5332)</li>
<li>Bump babel-plugin-relay from 11.0.2 to 13.2.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5333)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-patterns-filters-applications">
	🔋 Patterns, Filters, Applications
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI] Card view of Design Page @asubedy (#5339)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Remove wrk2 submodule @leecalcote (#5384)</li>
<li>Bump async from 3.2.0 to 3.2.3 in /ui @dependabot (#5381)</li>
<li>Bump async from 3.2.0 to 3.2.3 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5380)</li>
<li>Revert &ldquo;[CI] Use mesheryctl to start adapters in CI&rdquo; @gr455 (#5379)</li>
<li>fix(#5342): image version to edge-latest for meshery-perf @gkarthiks (#5344)</li>
<li>[CI] Use mesheryctl to start adapters in CI @gr455 (#5361)</li>
<li>Bump moment from 2.29.1 to 2.29.2 in /ui @dependabot (#5362)</li>
<li>Bump @types/react-relay from 11.0.2 to 13.0.2 in /ui @dependabot (#5332)</li>
<li>Bump babel-plugin-relay from 11.0.2 to 13.2.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5333)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/99designs/gqlgen from 0.17.1 to 0.17.2 @dependabot (#5324)</li>
<li>[CI] Upgrade setup-go version @alphaX86 (#5354)</li>
<li>[CI] Docker Extension for Meshery workflow @leecalcote (#5352)</li>
<li>[CI] DDE: Fix release channel logic @leecalcote (#5349)</li>
<li>Updated Contributing-gitflow(Readme) @Nandani-Paliwal (#5313)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump nokogiri from 1.13.3 to 1.13.4 in /docs @dependabot (#5370)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>
