<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc.5n</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc.5n">Released</a> on April 20, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>removed elevation @warunicorn19 (#5416)</li>
<li>added meshsync animation to dde @warunicorn19 (#5415)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Improved UX for bash script installer @cpepper96 (#5371)</li>
<li>Adds HPE Security Engineering as adopter @mchurichi (#5382)</li>
<li>[Visualiser] Add Cluster Name To Visualiser @theBeginner86 (#5348)</li>
<li>Fix failing kubeopenapi binary due to missing library @Revolyssup (#5373)</li>
<li>[Docker Extension] Proxy: remove unnecessary caps @leecalcote (#5369)</li>
<li>[CI] Made changes to Makefile to enforce usage of go v1.17.8 @asubedy (#5367)</li>
<li>[DDE] Setup Golang proxy for the UI to be able to communicate with Meshery Server @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5365)</li>
<li>[Bug] - Fixed Upstream URL Issue @adithyaakrishna (#5359)</li>
<li>potential fix for dde icon @warunicorn19 (#5358)</li>
<li>dde_css @warunicorn19 (#5356)</li>
<li>Update ADOPTERS.md @samirparhi-dev (#5353)</li>
<li>[CI] Workflow DDE @leecalcote (#5351)</li>
<li>Changed Description @hershd23 (#5350)</li>
<li>small changes in dde @warunicorn19 (#5347)</li>
<li>added browse in dde @warunicorn19 (#5343)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>fix the context parsing logic in system config subcommand #5408 @Revolyssup (#5411)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] fix the panic issue in system config minikube command @hexxdump (#5402)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>increased size of tooltip @warunicorn19 (#5410)</li>
<li>[UI] dev server build Failure due to eslint upgrades @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5403)</li>
<li>Fix notifications not showing up. @MUzairS15 (#5401)</li>
<li>[UI]Added arrow on hovering Collapsed SideNav @Harshit-Dandriyal (#5297)</li>
<li>fix: update operation not working from codemirror @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5398)</li>
<li>[UI]Designed Multi Cluster Context Switcher Search Box and Chip @Harshit-Dandriyal (#5310)</li>
<li>Bump async from 3.2.0 to 3.2.3 in /ui @dependabot (#5381)</li>
<li>Bump async from 3.2.0 to 3.2.3 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5380)</li>
<li>fix: extension class conflicts due to mui makestyles classNames conflicts @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5383)</li>
<li>Fix: Select All not working @MUzairS15 (#5378)</li>
<li>[UI] Card view of Design Page @asubedy (#5339)</li>
<li>[Extension] Use loading component from extension point @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5372)</li>
<li>[RJSF] Support Lazy loading of components tooltip in Exntension @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5363)</li>
<li>Bump moment from 2.29.1 to 2.29.2 in /ui @dependabot (#5362)</li>
<li>Bump @types/react-relay from 11.0.2 to 13.0.2 in /ui @dependabot (#5332)</li>
<li>Bump babel-plugin-relay from 11.0.2 to 13.2.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5333)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-patterns-filters-applications">
	🔋 Patterns, Filters, Applications
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Do not change service name in patternfile for designs unless duplicated @Revolyssup (#5400)</li>
<li>fix: update operation not working from codemirror @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5398)</li>
<li>[UI] Card view of Design Page @asubedy (#5339)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-bug-fixes">
	🐛 Bug Fixes
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Bug] Fix Panic @theBeginner86 (#5412)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Service Mesh Provisioning for DDE @warunicorn19 (#5346)</li>
<li>Implement docker-compose to kubernetes manifest conversion using Kompose @leecalcote (#5394)</li>
<li>[CI] Helm: Upgrade Helm docs library @leecalcote (#5407)</li>
<li>Remove wrk2 submodule @leecalcote (#5384)</li>
<li>Bump async from 3.2.0 to 3.2.3 in /ui @dependabot (#5381)</li>
<li>Bump async from 3.2.0 to 3.2.3 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5380)</li>
<li>Revert &ldquo;[CI] Use mesheryctl to start adapters in CI&rdquo; @gr455 (#5379)</li>
<li>fix(#5342): image version to edge-latest for meshery-perf @gkarthiks (#5344)</li>
<li>[CI] Use mesheryctl to start adapters in CI @gr455 (#5361)</li>
<li>Bump moment from 2.29.1 to 2.29.2 in /ui @dependabot (#5362)</li>
<li>Bump @types/react-relay from 11.0.2 to 13.0.2 in /ui @dependabot (#5332)</li>
<li>Bump babel-plugin-relay from 11.0.2 to 13.2.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5333)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/99designs/gqlgen from 0.17.1 to 0.17.2 @dependabot (#5324)</li>
<li>[CI] Upgrade setup-go version @alphaX86 (#5354)</li>
<li>[CI] Docker Extension for Meshery workflow @leecalcote (#5352)</li>
<li>[CI] DDE: Fix release channel logic @leecalcote (#5349)</li>
<li>Updated Contributing-gitflow(Readme) @Nandani-Paliwal (#5313)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Service Mesh Provisioning for DDE @warunicorn19 (#5346)</li>
<li>Bump nokogiri from 1.13.3 to 1.13.4 in /docs @dependabot (#5370)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Harshit-Dandriyal, @MUzairS15, @Nandani-Paliwal, @Revolyssup, @adithyaakrishna, @alphaX86, @asubedy, @cpepper96, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @gkarthiks, @gr455, @hershd23, @hexxdump, @l5io, @leecalcote, @mchurichi, @samirparhi-dev, @sudo-NithishKarthik, @theBeginner86 and @warunicorn19</p>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc.5o</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc.5o">Released</a> on April 20, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Chore] Makefile to display required golang version @leecalcote (#5417)</li>
<li>removed elevation @warunicorn19 (#5416)</li>
<li>added meshsync animation to dde @warunicorn19 (#5415)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Improved UX for bash script installer @cpepper96 (#5371)</li>
<li>Adds HPE Security Engineering as adopter @mchurichi (#5382)</li>
<li>[Visualiser] Add Cluster Name To Visualiser @theBeginner86 (#5348)</li>
<li>Fix failing kubeopenapi binary due to missing library @Revolyssup (#5373)</li>
<li>[Docker Extension] Proxy: remove unnecessary caps @leecalcote (#5369)</li>
<li>[CI] Made changes to Makefile to enforce usage of go v1.17.8 @asubedy (#5367)</li>
<li>[DDE] Setup Golang proxy for the UI to be able to communicate with Meshery Server @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5365)</li>
<li>[Bug] - Fixed Upstream URL Issue @adithyaakrishna (#5359)</li>
<li>potential fix for dde icon @warunicorn19 (#5358)</li>
<li>dde_css @warunicorn19 (#5356)</li>
<li>Update ADOPTERS.md @samirparhi-dev (#5353)</li>
<li>[CI] Workflow DDE @leecalcote (#5351)</li>
<li>Changed Description @hershd23 (#5350)</li>
<li>small changes in dde @warunicorn19 (#5347)</li>
<li>added browse in dde @warunicorn19 (#5343)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>fix the context parsing logic in system config subcommand #5408 @Revolyssup (#5411)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] fix the panic issue in system config minikube command @hexxdump (#5402)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>increased size of tooltip @warunicorn19 (#5410)</li>
<li>[UI] dev server build Failure due to eslint upgrades @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5403)</li>
<li>Fix notifications not showing up. @MUzairS15 (#5401)</li>
<li>[UI]Added arrow on hovering Collapsed SideNav @Harshit-Dandriyal (#5297)</li>
<li>fix: update operation not working from codemirror @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5398)</li>
<li>[UI]Designed Multi Cluster Context Switcher Search Box and Chip @Harshit-Dandriyal (#5310)</li>
<li>Bump async from 3.2.0 to 3.2.3 in /ui @dependabot (#5381)</li>
<li>Bump async from 3.2.0 to 3.2.3 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5380)</li>
<li>fix: extension class conflicts due to mui makestyles classNames conflicts @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5383)</li>
<li>Fix: Select All not working @MUzairS15 (#5378)</li>
<li>[UI] Card view of Design Page @asubedy (#5339)</li>
<li>[Extension] Use loading component from extension point @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5372)</li>
<li>[RJSF] Support Lazy loading of components tooltip in Exntension @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5363)</li>
<li>Bump moment from 2.29.1 to 2.29.2 in /ui @dependabot (#5362)</li>
<li>Bump @types/react-relay from 11.0.2 to 13.0.2 in /ui @dependabot (#5332)</li>
<li>Bump babel-plugin-relay from 11.0.2 to 13.2.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5333)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-patterns-filters-applications">
	🔋 Patterns, Filters, Applications
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Do not change service name in patternfile for designs unless duplicated @Revolyssup (#5400)</li>
<li>fix: update operation not working from codemirror @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5398)</li>
<li>[UI] Card view of Design Page @asubedy (#5339)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-bug-fixes">
	🐛 Bug Fixes
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Bug] Fix Panic @theBeginner86 (#5412)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Service Mesh Provisioning for DDE @warunicorn19 (#5346)</li>
<li>Implement docker-compose to kubernetes manifest conversion using Kompose @leecalcote (#5394)</li>
<li>[CI] Helm: Upgrade Helm docs library @leecalcote (#5407)</li>
<li>Remove wrk2 submodule @leecalcote (#5384)</li>
<li>Bump async from 3.2.0 to 3.2.3 in /ui @dependabot (#5381)</li>
<li>Bump async from 3.2.0 to 3.2.3 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5380)</li>
<li>Revert &ldquo;[CI] Use mesheryctl to start adapters in CI&rdquo; @gr455 (#5379)</li>
<li>fix(#5342): image version to edge-latest for meshery-perf @gkarthiks (#5344)</li>
<li>[CI] Use mesheryctl to start adapters in CI @gr455 (#5361)</li>
<li>Bump moment from 2.29.1 to 2.29.2 in /ui @dependabot (#5362)</li>
<li>Bump @types/react-relay from 11.0.2 to 13.0.2 in /ui @dependabot (#5332)</li>
<li>Bump babel-plugin-relay from 11.0.2 to 13.2.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5333)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/99designs/gqlgen from 0.17.1 to 0.17.2 @dependabot (#5324)</li>
<li>[CI] Upgrade setup-go version @alphaX86 (#5354)</li>
<li>[CI] Docker Extension for Meshery workflow @leecalcote (#5352)</li>
<li>[CI] DDE: Fix release channel logic @leecalcote (#5349)</li>
<li>Updated Contributing-gitflow(Readme) @Nandani-Paliwal (#5313)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Service Mesh Provisioning for DDE @warunicorn19 (#5346)</li>
<li>Bump nokogiri from 1.13.3 to 1.13.4 in /docs @dependabot (#5370)</li>
</ul>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc.5p</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc.5p">Released</a> on April 21, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Chore] Makefile to display required golang version @leecalcote (#5417)</li>
<li>removed elevation @warunicorn19 (#5416)</li>
<li>added meshsync animation to dde @warunicorn19 (#5415)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Improved UX for bash script installer @cpepper96 (#5371)</li>
<li>Adds HPE Security Engineering as adopter @mchurichi (#5382)</li>
<li>[Visualiser] Add Cluster Name To Visualiser @theBeginner86 (#5348)</li>
<li>Fix failing kubeopenapi binary due to missing library @Revolyssup (#5373)</li>
<li>[Docker Extension] Proxy: remove unnecessary caps @leecalcote (#5369)</li>
<li>[CI] Made changes to Makefile to enforce usage of go v1.17.8 @asubedy (#5367)</li>
<li>[DDE] Setup Golang proxy for the UI to be able to communicate with Meshery Server @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5365)</li>
<li>[Bug] - Fixed Upstream URL Issue @adithyaakrishna (#5359)</li>
<li>potential fix for dde icon @warunicorn19 (#5358)</li>
<li>dde_css @warunicorn19 (#5356)</li>
<li>Update ADOPTERS.md @samirparhi-dev (#5353)</li>
<li>[CI] Workflow DDE @leecalcote (#5351)</li>
<li>Changed Description @hershd23 (#5350)</li>
<li>small changes in dde @warunicorn19 (#5347)</li>
<li>added browse in dde @warunicorn19 (#5343)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>fix the context parsing logic in system config subcommand #5408 @Revolyssup (#5411)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] fix the panic issue in system config minikube command @hexxdump (#5402)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Extension] fixes UI breaks in meshery-extension @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5420)</li>
<li>Fix invalid metadata @warunicorn19 (#5418)</li>
<li>increased size of tooltip @warunicorn19 (#5410)</li>
<li>[UI] dev server build Failure due to eslint upgrades @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5403)</li>
<li>Fix notifications not showing up. @MUzairS15 (#5401)</li>
<li>[UI]Added arrow on hovering Collapsed SideNav @Harshit-Dandriyal (#5297)</li>
<li>fix: update operation not working from codemirror @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5398)</li>
<li>[UI]Designed Multi Cluster Context Switcher Search Box and Chip @Harshit-Dandriyal (#5310)</li>
<li>Bump async from 3.2.0 to 3.2.3 in /ui @dependabot (#5381)</li>
<li>Bump async from 3.2.0 to 3.2.3 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5380)</li>
<li>fix: extension class conflicts due to mui makestyles classNames conflicts @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5383)</li>
<li>Fix: Select All not working @MUzairS15 (#5378)</li>
<li>[UI] Card view of Design Page @asubedy (#5339)</li>
<li>[Extension] Use loading component from extension point @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5372)</li>
<li>[RJSF] Support Lazy loading of components tooltip in Exntension @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5363)</li>
<li>Bump moment from 2.29.1 to 2.29.2 in /ui @dependabot (#5362)</li>
<li>Bump @types/react-relay from 11.0.2 to 13.0.2 in /ui @dependabot (#5332)</li>
<li>Bump babel-plugin-relay from 11.0.2 to 13.2.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5333)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-patterns-filters-applications">

</h2>
<ul>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc.5q</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc.5q">Released</a> on May 09, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[DDE] Support Login feature work with docker compose import  @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5490)</li>
<li>[Server] Add version details for MeshSync and Broker @MUzairS15 (#5480)</li>
<li>fix for meshery logo for dde @warunicorn19 (#5477)</li>
<li>[DDE] [Refactor] Configure authentication with proxy  @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5467)</li>
<li>added a lighter color and toaster @warunicorn19 (#5465)</li>
<li>Added <code>namespaced</code> field into kubernetes oam definition.metadata @Revolyssup (#5447)</li>
<li>Dde light mode support @warunicorn19 (#5439)</li>
<li>Bump ejs from 3.1.6 to 3.1.7 in /install/docker-extension/ui @dependabot (#5436)</li>
<li>updated image in dde description @warunicorn19 (#5425)</li>
<li>Remove older hack for namespace creation @Revolyssup (#5423)</li>
<li>[Chore] Makefile to display required golang version @leecalcote (#5417)</li>
<li>removed elevation @warunicorn19 (#5416)</li>
<li>added meshsync animation to dde @warunicorn19 (#5415)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Improved UX for bash script installer @cpepper96 (#5371)</li>
<li>Adds HPE Security Engineering as adopter @mchurichi (#5382)</li>
<li>[Visualiser] Add Cluster Name To Visualiser @theBeginner86 (#5348)</li>
<li>Fix failing kubeopenapi binary due to missing library @Revolyssup (#5373)</li>
<li>[Docker Extension] Proxy: remove unnecessary caps @leecalcote (#5369)</li>
<li>[CI] Made changes to Makefile to enforce usage of go v1.17.8 @asubedy (#5367)</li>
<li>[DDE] Setup Golang proxy for the UI to be able to communicate with Meshery Server @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5365)</li>
<li>[Bug] - Fixed Upstream URL Issue @adithyaakrishna (#5359)</li>
<li>potential fix for dde icon @warunicorn19 (#5358)</li>
<li>dde_css @warunicorn19 (#5356)</li>
<li>Update ADOPTERS.md @samirparhi-dev (#5353)</li>
<li>[CI] Workflow DDE @leecalcote (#5351)</li>
<li>Changed Description @hershd23 (#5350)</li>
<li>small changes in dde @warunicorn19 (#5347)</li>
<li>added browse in dde @warunicorn19 (#5343)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-features">
	🚀 Features
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[graphql] added kubectl describe graphql endpoint @piyushsingariya (#5391)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[mesheryctl] Fallback to force cleanup in system stop @piyushsingariya (#5429)</li>
<li>updated_error_message @Akshit42-hue (#5424)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Implement URL support for pattern delete @gr455 (#5404)</li>
<li>fix the context parsing logic in system config subcommand #5408 @Revolyssup (#5411)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] fix the panic issue in system config minikube command @hexxdump (#5402)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Revert &ldquo;[Extension] load only Single page extension on desktop-desktop env&rdquo; @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5495)</li>
<li>[Extension] load only Single page extension on desktop-desktop env @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5476)</li>
<li>[UI] JSS: Dependency update @leecalcote (#5368)</li>

<li>Bump react-slick from 0.28.1 to 0.29.0 in /ui @dependabot (#5453)</li>

<li>[UI] add hook for disable page routing on unsaved contents @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5442)</li>
<li>[UI] [Pattern] changed minor bugs on MesheryPattern.js @asubedy (#5406)</li>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc.5r</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc.5r">Released</a> on May 13, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">

</h2>
<ul>

<li>added a lighter color and toaster @warunicorn19 (#5465)</li>

<li>Dde light mode support @warunicorn19 (#5439)</li>

<li>[Visualiser] Add Cluster Name To Visualiser @theBeginner86 (#5348)</li>
<li>Fix failing kubeopenapi binary due to missing library @Revolyssup (#5373)</li>

<li>added browse in dde @warunicorn19 (#5343)</li>
</ul>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc.5s</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc.5s">Released</a> on June 07, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Replace <code>kubeopenapi-jsonschema</code> based component generation with CUE @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5549)</li>
<li>Fix manifest URL for argo rollouts[Application] @Revolyssup (#5546)</li>
<li>pull_policy: always @Revolyssup (#5521)</li>
<li>added an initial walkthrough for dde @warunicorn19 (#5509)</li>
<li>adding the loading animation @warunicorn19 (#5520)</li>
<li>Allow connecting to multiple brokers[panic fixed] @Revolyssup (#5513)</li>
<li>Reinstate wrk2 submodule @alphaX86 (#5506)</li>
<li>Fix wrk2 submodule @alphaX86 (#5505)</li>
<li>[Server] [Bug] Fix Cilium deployments not showing in UI. @MUzairS15 (#5443)</li>
<li>[DDE] Fix WebSocket Proxy issue @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5503)</li>
<li>responsiveness to DDE @warunicorn19 (#5500)</li>
<li>fix: Auth token effect refinement @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5498)</li>
<li>Extension @warunicorn19 (#5497)</li>
<li>[DDE] Support Login feature work with docker compose import  @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5490)</li>
<li>[Server] Add version details for MeshSync and Broker @MUzairS15 (#5480)</li>
<li>fix for meshery logo for dde @warunicorn19 (#5477)</li>
<li>[DDE] [Refactor] Configure authentication with proxy  @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5467)</li>
<li>added a lighter color and toaster @warunicorn19 (#5465)</li>
<li>Added <code>namespaced</code> field into kubernetes oam definition.metadata @Revolyssup (#5447)</li>
<li>Dde light mode support @warunicorn19 (#5439)</li>
<li>Bump ejs from 3.1.6 to 3.1.7 in /install/docker-extension/ui @dependabot (#5436)</li>
<li>updated image in dde description @warunicorn19 (#5425)</li>
<li>Remove older hack for namespace creation @Revolyssup (#5423)</li>
<li>[Chore] Makefile to display required golang version @leecalcote (#5417)</li>
<li>removed elevation @warunicorn19 (#5416)</li>
<li>added meshsync animation to dde @warunicorn19 (#5415)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Improved UX for bash script installer @cpepper96 (#5371)</li>
<li>Adds HPE Security Engineering as adopter @mchurichi (#5382)</li>
<li>[Visualiser] Add Cluster Name To Visualiser @theBeginner86 (#5348)</li>
<li>Fix failing kubeopenapi binary due to missing library @Revolyssup (#5373)</li>
<li>[Docker Extension] Proxy: remove unnecessary caps @leecalcote (#5369)</li>
<li>[CI] Made changes to Makefile to enforce usage of go v1.17.8 @asubedy (#5367)</li>
<li>[DDE] Setup Golang proxy for the UI to be able to communicate with Meshery Server @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5365)</li>
<li>[Bug] - Fixed Upstream URL Issue @adithyaakrishna (#5359)</li>
<li>potential fix for dde icon @warunicorn19 (#5358)</li>
<li>dde_css @warunicorn19 (#5356)</li>
<li>Update ADOPTERS.md @samirparhi-dev (#5353)</li>
<li>[CI] Workflow DDE @leecalcote (#5351)</li>
<li>Changed Description @hershd23 (#5350)</li>
<li>small changes in dde @warunicorn19 (#5347)</li>
<li>added browse in dde @warunicorn19 (#5343)</li>
</ul>

	🚀 Features
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[graphql] added kubectl describe graphql endpoint @piyushsingariya (#5391)</li>
</ul>

</h2>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc.5u</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc.5u">Released</a> on June 09, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[dde] UI Change to adapt to the exposed server version @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5596)</li>
<li>fix: Service mesh provisioning @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5595)</li>
<li>exposed meshery server version in dde @warunicorn19 (#5591)</li>
<li>Fix panic @Revolyssup (#5593)</li>
<li>Fix NATS connectivity test @MUzairS15 (#5583)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI] Pattern file bug fixes @Chadha93 (#5587)</li>
<li>[UI] Settings button style fix for lifecycle @Chadha93 (#5588)</li>
<li>material-ui/core from 4.12.3 to 4.12.4 @Harshit-Dandriyal (#5585)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-patterns-filters-applications">
	🔋 Patterns, Filters, Applications
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI] Pattern file bug fixes @Chadha93 (#5587)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.46.0 to 1.47.0 @dependabot (#5560)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">

</h2>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc.5v</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc.5v">Released</a> on June 10, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[dde] UI Change to adapt to the exposed server version @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5596)</li>
<li>fix: Service mesh provisioning @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5595)</li>
<li>exposed meshery server version in dde @warunicorn19 (#5591)</li>
<li>Fix panic @Revolyssup (#5593)</li>
<li>Fix NATS connectivity test @MUzairS15 (#5583)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Multi context refactor @Revolyssup (#5528)</li>
<li>Ci/marioarriaga92/5592 fix cypress v10 legacy config file error @MarioArriaga92 (#5597)</li>
<li>[UI] Pattern file bug fixes @Chadha93 (#5587)</li>
<li>[UI] Settings button style fix for lifecycle @Chadha93 (#5588)</li>
<li>material-ui/core from 4.12.3 to 4.12.4 @Harshit-Dandriyal (#5585)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-patterns-filters-applications">
	🔋 Patterns, Filters, Applications
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI] Pattern file bug fixes @Chadha93 (#5587)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.46.0 to 1.47.0 @dependabot (#5560)</li>
</ul>

</h2>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc.5w</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc.5w">Released</a> on June 11, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Fix failing save context for incluster @Revolyssup (#5601)</li>
<li>[dde] UI Change to adapt to the exposed server version @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5596)</li>
<li>fix: Service mesh provisioning @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5595)</li>
<li>exposed meshery server version in dde @warunicorn19 (#5591)</li>
<li>Fix panic @Revolyssup (#5593)</li>
<li>Fix NATS connectivity test @MUzairS15 (#5583)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Multi context refactor @Revolyssup (#5528)</li>
<li>Ci/marioarriaga92/5592 fix cypress v10 legacy config file error @MarioArriaga92 (#5597)</li>
<li>[UI] Pattern file bug fixes @Chadha93 (#5587)</li>
<li>[UI] Settings button style fix for lifecycle @Chadha93 (#5588)</li>
<li>material-ui/core from 4.12.3 to 4.12.4 @Harshit-Dandriyal (#5585)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-patterns-filters-applications">
	🔋 Patterns, Filters, Applications
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI] Pattern file bug fixes @Chadha93 (#5587)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.46.0 to 1.47.0 @dependabot (#5560)</li>
</ul>

</h2>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc.5x</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc.5x">Released</a> on June 16, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Server] Fix error code conflicts @gr455 (#5626)</li>
<li>Allow provider to be set via query parameter @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5627)</li>
<li>Fix failing save context for incluster @Revolyssup (#5601)</li>
<li>[dde] UI Change to adapt to the exposed server version @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5596)</li>
<li>fix: Service mesh provisioning @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5595)</li>
<li>exposed meshery server version in dde @warunicorn19 (#5591)</li>
<li>Fix panic @Revolyssup (#5593)</li>
<li>Fix NATS connectivity test @MUzairS15 (#5583)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Fix problems with context-switching operation from Header @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5625)</li>
<li>Fix: Metrics components not showing up in dashboard @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5624)</li>
<li>Fix Event Streams in Meshery Notification Center @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5621)</li>
<li>lifecycle minor bug fix with no adapter @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5620)</li>
<li>Bug fixes @MUzairS15 (#5611)</li>
<li>[Fix] Lifecylce Page Fixes @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5614)</li>
<li>Bump eslint-plugin-react from 7.29.4 to 7.30.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5580)</li>
<li>Improve UI @MUzairS15 (#5602)</li>
<li>Bump @babel/eslint-parser from 7.17.0 to 7.18.2 in /ui @dependabot (#5555)</li>
<li>Multi context refactor @Revolyssup (#5528)</li>
<li>Ci/marioarriaga92/5592 fix cypress v10 legacy config file error @MarioArriaga92 (#5597)</li>
<li>[UI] Pattern file bug fixes @Chadha93 (#5587)</li>
<li>[UI] Settings button style fix for lifecycle @Chadha93 (#5588)</li>
<li>material-ui/core from 4.12.3 to 4.12.4 @Harshit-Dandriyal (#5585)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-patterns-filters-applications">
	🔋 Patterns, Filters, Applications
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI] Pattern file bug fixes @Chadha93 (#5587)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Fix golangci-lint failures @haanhvu (#5612)</li>
<li>Bump eslint-plugin-react from 7.29.4 to 7.30.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5580)</li>
<li>[Lifecycle] Remove CPX from default config @leecalcote (#5604)</li>
<li>Bump @babel/eslint-parser from 7.17.0 to 7.18.2 in /ui @dependabot (#5555)</li>
<li>Bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.46.0 to 1.47.0 @dependabot (#5560)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Doc] Add troubleshooting steps for Service Mesh installation @MUzairS15 (#5616)</li>
</ul>

</h2>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc.5y</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc.5y">Released</a> on June 17, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Fix validation error and whitespacing bug @Revolyssup (#5644)</li>
<li>Logout button move @warunicorn19 (#5641)</li>
<li>upgrade meshkit @Revolyssup (#5637)</li>
<li>[DDE] Fix: dde ws undefined @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5636)</li>
<li>[DDE] Fix: Set isLogged to false after logging out @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5635)</li>
<li>[DDE] Fix: automatically change state once logged out @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5634)</li>
<li>fixed issue with logo before login and added logout button @warunicorn19 (#5630)</li>
<li>[Server] Fix error code conflicts @gr455 (#5626)</li>
<li>Allow provider to be set via query parameter @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5627)</li>
<li>Fix failing save context for incluster @Revolyssup (#5601)</li>
<li>[dde] UI Change to adapt to the exposed server version @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5596)</li>
<li>fix: Service mesh provisioning @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5595)</li>
<li>exposed meshery server version in dde @warunicorn19 (#5591)</li>
<li>Fix panic @Revolyssup (#5593)</li>
<li>Fix NATS connectivity test @MUzairS15 (#5583)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Meshery-Settings: Enable Subscriptions and fix problems with settings page @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5645)</li>
<li>[UI]Changed cursor to pointer @Rohith-Raju (#5632)</li>
<li>Add operator status query @MUzairS15 (#5633)</li>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc.5z</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc.5z">Released</a> on June 18, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Refactor] Make use of validation and formatting functions exposed in Meshkit @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5650)</li>
<li>[DDE] Refactor ws channels  in proxy @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5648)</li>
<li>refactor: Refine ws connection for logout @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5647)</li>
<li>Fix validation error and whitespacing bug @Revolyssup (#5644)</li>
<li>Logout button move @warunicorn19 (#5641)</li>
<li>upgrade meshkit @Revolyssup (#5637)</li>
<li>[DDE] Fix: dde ws undefined @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5636)</li>
<li>[DDE] Fix: Set isLogged to false after logging out @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5635)</li>
<li>[DDE] Fix: automatically change state once logged out @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5634)</li>
<li>fixed issue with logo before login and added logout button @warunicorn19 (#5630)</li>
<li>[Server] Fix error code conflicts @gr455 (#5626)</li>
<li>Allow provider to be set via query parameter @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5627)</li>
<li>Fix failing save context for incluster @Revolyssup (#5601)</li>
<li>[dde] UI Change to adapt to the exposed server version @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5596)</li>
<li>fix: Service mesh provisioning @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5595)</li>
<li>exposed meshery server version in dde @warunicorn19 (#5591)</li>
<li>Fix panic @Revolyssup (#5593)</li>
<li>Fix NATS connectivity test @MUzairS15 (#5583)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Meshery-Settings: Enable Subscriptions and fix problems with settings page @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5645)</li>
<li>[UI]Changed cursor to pointer @Rohith-Raju (#5632)</li>
<li>Add operator status query @MUzairS15 (#5633)</li>
<li>[UI] Undeploy card view button color update @Chadha93 (#5640)</li>
<li>[UI] Support for Undeploy Pattern and Applications @Chadha93 (#5617)</li>
<li>Fix problems with context-switching operation from Header @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5625)</li>
<li>Fix: Metrics components not showing up in dashboard @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5624)</li>
<li>Fix Event Streams in Meshery Notification Center @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5621)</li>
<li>lifecycle minor bug fix with no adapter @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5620)</li>
<li>Bug fixes @MUzairS15 (#5611)</li>
<li>[Fix] Lifecylce Page Fixes @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5614)</li>
<li>Bump eslint-plugin-react from 7.29.4 to 7.30.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5580)</li>
<li>Improve UI @MUzairS15 (#5602)</li>
<li>Bump @babel/eslint-parser from 7.17.0 to 7.18.2 in /ui @dependabot (#5555)</li>
<li>Multi context refactor @Revolyssup (#5528)</li>
<li>Ci/marioarriaga92/5592 fix cypress v10 legacy config file error @MarioArriaga92 (#5597)</li>
<li>[UI] Pattern file bug fixes @Chadha93 (#5587)</li>
<li>[UI] Settings button style fix for lifecycle @Chadha93 (#5588)</li>
<li>material-ui/core from 4.12.3 to 4.12.4 @Harshit-Dandriyal (#5585)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-patterns-filters-applications">
	🔋 Patterns, Filters, Applications
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI] Undeploy card view button color update @Chadha93 (#5640)</li>
<li>[UI] Support for Undeploy Pattern and Applications @Chadha93 (#5617)</li>
<li>[UI] Pattern file bug fixes @Chadha93 (#5587)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Chore] Upgrade Dependencies @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5651)</li>
<li>Fix golangci-lint failures @haanhvu (#5612)</li>
<li>Bump eslint-plugin-react from 7.29.4 to 7.30.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5580)</li>
<li>[Lifecycle] Remove CPX from default config @leecalcote (#5604)</li>
<li>Bump @babel/eslint-parser from 7.17.0 to 7.18.2 in /ui @dependabot (#5555)</li>
<li>Bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.46.0 to 1.47.0 @dependabot (#5560)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Docs] Additional guides/troubleshoot installation links in quickstart @abhiyant-10 (#5646)</li>
<li>[Doc] Add troubleshooting steps for Service Mesh installation @MUzairS15 (#5616)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Chadha93, @Harshit-Dandriyal, @MUzairS15, @MarioArriaga92, @Revolyssup, @Rohith-Raju, @abhiyant-10, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @gr455, @haanhvu, @l5io, @leecalcote, @sudo-NithishKarthik, @warunicorn19 and Nithish</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc.6</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc.6">Released</a> on June 26, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Refactor] Make use of validation and formatting functions exposed in Meshkit @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5650)</li>
<li>[DDE] Refactor ws channels  in proxy @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5648)</li>
<li>refactor: Refine ws connection for logout @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5647)</li>
<li>Fix validation error and whitespacing bug @Revolyssup (#5644)</li>
<li>Logout button move @warunicorn19 (#5641)</li>
<li>upgrade meshkit @Revolyssup (#5637)</li>
<li>[DDE] Fix: dde ws undefined @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5636)</li>
<li>[DDE] Fix: Set isLogged to false after logging out @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5635)</li>
<li>[DDE] Fix: automatically change state once logged out @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5634)</li>
<li>fixed issue with logo before login and added logout button @warunicorn19 (#5630)</li>
<li>[Server] Fix error code conflicts @gr455 (#5626)</li>
<li>Allow provider to be set via query parameter @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5627)</li>
<li>Fix failing save context for incluster @Revolyssup (#5601)</li>
<li>[dde] UI Change to adapt to the exposed server version @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5596)</li>
<li>fix: Service mesh provisioning @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5595)</li>
<li>exposed meshery server version in dde @warunicorn19 (#5591)</li>
<li>Fix panic @Revolyssup (#5593)</li>
<li>Fix NATS connectivity test @MUzairS15 (#5583)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>leecalcote/chore/ui deps @leecalcote (#5674)</li>
<li>Make table style consistent @MUzairS15 (#5671)</li>
<li>Changes to the un-deploy icon @asubedy (#5670)</li>
<li>reverted bad commits @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5665)</li>
<li>[Refactor] Update the RJSF form to be overridden by its consumers @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5659)</li>
<li>[Operator Subscription] Fix state variables showing outdated results in callback Fn @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5656)</li>
<li>minor ui fixes @warunicorn19 (#5655)</li>
<li>[Extension] Support for Account Extension @theBeginner86 (#5615)</li>
<li>[Build Failure] [object Object] is not a PostCSS plugin @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5653)</li>
<li>Meshery-Settings: Enable Subscriptions and fix problems with settings page @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5645)</li>
<li>[UI]Changed cursor to pointer @Rohith-Raju (#5632)</li>
<li>Add operator status query @MUzairS15 (#5633)</li>
<li>[UI] Undeploy card view button color update @Chadha93 (#5640)</li>
<li>[UI] Support for Undeploy Pattern and Applications @Chadha93 (#5617)</li>
<li>Fix problems with context-switching operation from Header @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5625)</li>
<li>Fix: Metrics components not showing up in dashboard @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5624)</li>
<li>Fix Event Streams in Meshery Notification Center @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5621)</li>
<li>lifecycle minor bug fix with no adapter @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5620)</li>
<li>Bug fixes @MUzairS15 (#5611)</li>
<li>[Fix] Lifecylce Page Fixes @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5614)</li>
<li>Bump eslint-plugin-react from 7.29.4 to 7.30.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5580)</li>
<li>Improve UI @MUzairS15 (#5602)</li>
<li>Bump @babel/eslint-parser from 7.17.0 to 7.18.2 in /ui @dependabot (#5555)</li>
<li>Multi context refactor @Revolyssup (#5528)</li>
<li>Ci/marioarriaga92/5592 fix cypress v10 legacy config file error @MarioArriaga92 (#5597)</li>
<li>[UI] Pattern file bug fixes @Chadha93 (#5587)</li>
<li>[UI] Settings button style fix for lifecycle @Chadha93 (#5588)</li>
<li>material-ui/core from 4.12.3 to 4.12.4 @Harshit-Dandriyal (#5585)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-patterns-filters-applications">
	🔋 Patterns, Filters, Applications
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI] Undeploy card view button color update @Chadha93 (#5640)</li>
<li>[UI] Support for Undeploy Pattern and Applications @Chadha93 (#5617)</li>
<li>[UI] Pattern file bug fixes @Chadha93 (#5587)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[CI] Chore: Docker image upgrade to lts-latest @leecalcote (#5673)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/99designs/gqlgen from 0.17.5 to 0.17.10 @dependabot (#5638)</li>
<li>[Chore] Upgrade Dependencies @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5651)</li>
<li>Fix golangci-lint failures @haanhvu (#5612)</li>
<li>Bump eslint-plugin-react from 7.29.4 to 7.30.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5580)</li>
<li>[Lifecycle] Remove CPX from default config @leecalcote (#5604)</li>
<li>Bump @babel/eslint-parser from 7.17.0 to 7.18.2 in /ui @dependabot (#5555)</li>
<li>Bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.46.0 to 1.47.0 @dependabot (#5560)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc.6a</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc.6a">Released</a> on July 04, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>refactor: Do not purge the database @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5753)</li>
<li>fix: Add essential middlewares for extension endpoints @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5751)</li>
<li>Upgrade k8s.io to 0.24 @Revolyssup (#5639)</li>
<li>fixed the upload of image for docker extension @harkiratsm (#5748)</li>
<li>fix: CustomResourceDefintions ref resolve @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5744)</li>
<li>[Chore] Update meshkit release and kompose conversion logic @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5719)</li>
<li>docker extension empty state fixed  @harkiratsm (#5684)</li>
<li>Remove extranous log including cert data  @Revolyssup (#5698)</li>
<li>Fixed logout buton alignment in meshery extension @Rohith-Raju (#5685)</li>
<li>[Refactor] Make use of validation and formatting functions exposed in Meshkit @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5650)</li>
<li>[DDE] Refactor ws channels  in proxy @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5648)</li>
<li>refactor: Refine ws connection for logout @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5647)</li>
<li>Fix validation error and whitespacing bug @Revolyssup (#5644)</li>
<li>Logout button move @warunicorn19 (#5641)</li>
<li>upgrade meshkit @Revolyssup (#5637)</li>
<li>[DDE] Fix: dde ws undefined @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5636)</li>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc.6b</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc.6b">Released</a> on July 07, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Changed the order of image  @harkiratsm (#5763)</li>
<li>refactor: Do not purge the database @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5753)</li>
<li>fix: Add essential middlewares for extension endpoints @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5751)</li>
<li>Upgrade k8s.io to 0.24 @Revolyssup (#5639)</li>
<li>fixed the upload of image for docker extension @harkiratsm (#5748)</li>
<li>fix: CustomResourceDefintions ref resolve @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5744)</li>
<li>[Chore] Update meshkit release and kompose conversion logic @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5719)</li>
<li>docker extension empty state fixed  @harkiratsm (#5684)</li>
<li>Remove extranous log including cert data  @Revolyssup (#5698)</li>
<li>Fixed logout buton alignment in meshery extension @Rohith-Raju (#5685)</li>
<li>[Refactor] Make use of validation and formatting functions exposed in Meshkit @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5650)</li>
<li>[DDE] Refactor ws channels  in proxy @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5648)</li>
<li>refactor: Refine ws connection for logout @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5647)</li>
<li>Fix validation error and whitespacing bug @Revolyssup (#5644)</li>
<li>Logout button move @warunicorn19 (#5641)</li>
<li>upgrade meshkit @Revolyssup (#5637)</li>
<li>[DDE] Fix: dde ws undefined @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5636)</li>
<li>[DDE] Fix: Set isLogged to false after logging out @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5635)</li>
<li>[DDE] Fix: automatically change state once logged out @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5634)</li>
<li>fixed issue with logo before login and added logout button @warunicorn19 (#5630)</li>
<li>[Server] Fix error code conflicts @gr455 (#5626)</li>
<li>Allow provider to be set via query parameter @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5627)</li>
<li>Fix failing save context for incluster @Revolyssup (#5601)</li>
<li>[dde] UI Change to adapt to the exposed server version @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5596)</li>
<li>fix: Service mesh provisioning @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5595)</li>
<li>exposed meshery server version in dde @warunicorn19 (#5591)</li>
<li>Fix panic @Revolyssup (#5593)</li>
<li>Fix NATS connectivity test @MUzairS15 (#5583)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
